Synopsis:
Orin, Chosen of Bhaal, has died by the DarkUrge's/party's hands.If the DU deafted Orin, Bhaal will celebrate his new Chosen and force a decision on them - accept him, or he will reclaim his blood from them.If the player was defeated, the player sees a linear scene where Bhaal inflicts his blood on them, leaving them with the urge to kill, but not his slayer powers.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BhaalTemple_PostBattleDarkUrge.json: The scene takes place in the Bhaal Temple immediately after Orin — the previous Chosen of Bhaal and a high‑profile antagonist who had been taunting the party — has been killed by the player or the party. Sceleritas Fel, the temple butler/door guardian, is transformed into an Avatar of Bhaal and uses Orin’s returned blood to announce you as Bhaal’s new Chosen, presenting a stark ultimatum: accept his “gift” (the Slayer form — stronger, crueller, the prime incarnation of murder) and serve him, or he will reclaim your life/blood. If the player was defeated instead of victorious, the sequence is linear and Bhaal forcibly infuses his blood into you, leaving a murderous urge but not granting the slayer powers; the exchange here echoes the game’s narrated temptation to either accept or cut your strings. This moment ties directly to the temple/Orin beats in Act II — Orin’s prior infiltration, abduction threats, and the temple’s sealed access — and can change subsequent story branches depending on whether you submit.

context: The scene takes place in the Bhaal Temple immediately after Orin — the former Chosen and the party’s taunting antagonist — has been killed. Sceleritas Fel, the temple butler, is transformed into an Avatar of Bhaal and returns Orin’s blood to the god, announcing the player as Bhaal’s new Chosen and offering the Slayer form: stronger, crueller, the prime incarnation of murder. Bhaal issues a stark ultimatum — accept this “gift” and serve him, or he will reclaim your life/blood — and if the player was defeated instead of victorious the sequence is linear: Bhaal forcibly infuses his blood, leaving a murderous urge but not granting Slayer powers. This moment follows the temple/Orin beats (abduction threats and sealed temple access) and can change later story branches and companion reactions depending on whether you submit.
